Progress driver — a duration clock over linear time. p = opening ? 1−raw : raw: the close runs 0→1 (modal → figure) and the open evaluates the identical field in time-reverse — the literal reverse animation macOS plays on restore — so both directions share one liquid surface. No global easing curve: the reference is linear-time by design — the motion character lives entirely in the per-row staggered eases (x rows ease-in-out, y rows ease-in so the suck accelerates into the card).
